audit.whatIsWrong: Three chart rows disagree with the packet. Packet is Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Vladimir, Vladimir, Vladimir; the pages read Garen, Garen, Skill, Garen, Skill, Skill, Vladimir. Row 7 also uses the non-champion token 'Vlad carry' on the full layer. diffRating is 8/10 while diff is 'EVEN' and the win rate is 51.54% over 3143 games (breakdown.trading even quotes 4.5/10, so the pages disagree with themselves).
audit.why: whys[2] says the level-3 all-in still beats his thin sustain (Garen), and whys[4]/whys[5] say he takes over at 5-6 (Vladimir). Packet and prose agree; only the chart tokens are wrong.
audit.corrected: Level 3 -> Garen 6/10; Level 6 and First item -> Vladimir 4/10; 2+ items token normalised to 'Vladimir'. diffRating 8/10 -> 5/10 and the difficulty prose restated as an even lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike describes Sanguine Pool vaguely as 'pools out of your Q dash and E' with no duration or cooldown.
audit.why: Riot's text: Vladimir is untargetable for 2 seconds; cooldown is 28/25/22/19/16, so 28s at rank 1. Untargetability is what actually voids Demacian Justice — a spent 120s ultimate — which is the real reason 6 flips the lane. Hemoplague makes affected enemies take increased damage, i.e. it amplifies all of his damage, not just its own.
audit.corrected: Give the 2s untargetable window and 28s rank-1 cooldown, and state that it eats Demacian Justice.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page says Tides of Blood is blocked by units, and report[5] quotes Sanguine Pool as 22s (rank 3).
audit.why: Riot's Tides of Blood text ends 'but can be blocked by enemy units' — standing behind your own minions denies his main poke, which directly changes the attrition lane the rest of the page is built on. Sanguine Pool is 28s at rank 1, the number that matters when you are picking a commit window.
audit.corrected: Add the minion-block line to Common Mistakes and correct the pool cooldown to 28s at rank 1.

audit.why: Itemization already buys Executioner's Calling on the first back and prioritises Mortal Reminder third, which is exactly the Grievous Wounds timing missingInteractions flags for Transfusion and Hemoplague.

edits.before: Track Vladimir’s Sanguine Pool (22s): Dodges your spin. Bait it. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Sanguine Pool is 28s at rank 1 and 2s untargetable — it eats your R. Bait it, then spend Judgment and Justice.

edits.before: Spin into his pool. Stack pure HP. Let him free-scale. Treat your ultimate as a verdict, never as harassment.
edits.after: Spin into his pool. Stack pure HP. Tides of Blood is blocked by minions — stand behind yours. Let him free-scale.

edits.before: Sanguine Pool plus Hemoplague flips control: he pools out of your Q dash and E, negating your all-in and adding an AoE amp for his damage.
edits.after: Sanguine Pool is 2s of untargetable on a 28s rank-1 cooldown: it eats Demacian Justice outright, and Hemoplague amps every source of his damage.

edits.after: Even lane — difficulty 5/10, Vladimir carry threat 8.5/10.
